scope: Shared Linux cloud host; synthetic published metrics and real local PTY. No live Slurm, physical GPU, remote terminal transport or emulator presentation measurement.
runtime_digest_method: Concatenate each tower/*.py filename UTF-8 followed by its bytes, in filename order, then SHA-256.

limitations: Elapsed timings include shared host scheduling variation.

Mouse motion is coalesced; latest dispatched latency differs from all decoded reports.
Source sampling cadence and evidence semantics are unchanged.
